incidents.summary: British Airways suffered a breach compromising around 420,000 people's data, received a £20 million regulatory fine and subsequently settled a victims' group action on undisclosed terms.

sources.title: BA Settles with Data Breach Victims - Infosecurity Magazine
sources.quote: Data belonging to around 420,000 people was compromised in a cyber-attack that went undetected for more than two months.

sources.title: BA Settles with Data Breach Victims - Infosecurity Magazine
sources.quote: BA, which is a subsidiary of International Airlines Group, was initially slapped with a record-breaking fine of £183m by the ICO for violating GDPR. The fine was later reduced to £20m.

sources.title: BA Settles with Data Breach Victims - Infosecurity Magazine
sources.quote: While settling the legal claim brought by some of the data breach victims, British Airways did not admit any liability.

incidents.summary: Spain's National Court upheld a €90,000 fine against Vueling for inadequate website accessibility for people with disabilities, finding continued violations and insufficient corrective action.

sources.title: Vueling fined 90,000 euros for not facilitating access to people with disabilities - Aviation24.be
sources.quote: The National Court of Spain has upheld a fine of €90,000 against Vueling Airlines for failing to provide adequate accessibility for people with disabilities on its website.

sources.title: Vueling fined 90,000 euros for not facilitating access to people with disabilities - Aviation24.be
sources.quote: Despite Vueling’s claims of good faith, the Court ruled that the sanctions were justified due to the continued violation and lack of corrective action.

incidents.summary: Unions announced strikes at IAG's South Europe Ground Services subsidiary, alleging payroll errors, low salaries, inadequate equipment maintenance and abbreviated training linked to increasing ramp incidents.

sources.title: Ground-handling strike at Madrid-Barajas set to hit Christmas and New-Year flights as unions target IAG’s low-cost subsidiary
sources.quote: unions USO and CGT confirmed a series of walk-outs at South Europe Ground Services (South), the newly created low-cost handling arm of International Airlines Group (IAG).

sources.title: Ground-handling strike at Madrid-Barajas set to hit Christmas and New-Year flights as unions target IAG’s low-cost subsidiary
sources.quote: Unions accuse the company of “low-costisation”: rapid hiring on sub-€18,000 salaries, high staff turnover, payroll errors, under-maintained equipment and abbreviated training they say is fuelling a rise in ramp incidents.

sources.title: Ground-handling strike at Madrid-Barajas set to hit Christmas and New-Year flights as unions target IAG’s low-cost subsidiary
sources.quote: Management counters that the model brings efficiency and competitiveness in line with EU market-opening rules.

incidents.summary: Around 130 Manchester-based Aer Lingus UK cabin crew escalated a pay dispute, with Unite alleging that starting salaries fell below the minimum wage.

sources.title: Manchester Airport to face further disruption due to strikes | News | International Airport Review
sources.quote: Unite the union confirmed that around 130 Aer Lingus UK cabin crew, all based at Manchester Airport’s Terminal 2, will stage additional walkouts on 9 to 11 November, 14 November and 16 to 18 November.

sources.title: Manchester Airport to face further disruption due to strikes | News | International Airport Review
sources.quote: According to the union, the starting salary for Manchester-based cabin crew is £17,640.25, which Unite says falls below the minimum wage.

sources.title: Manchester Airport to face further disruption due to strikes | News | International Airport Review
sources.quote: The industrial action follows the rejection of a pay deal offering a nine per cent rise this year and a further three per cent next year.

positives: Independent aviation analyst IBA cross-checked IAG's published 2018 and 2019 CO2 emissions against its calculator and found close agreement.
